content.text:
I couldn't get the height from Wikipedia because the browser tool is broken. I opened wikipedia.org in a new tab, but every tool that reads or acts on a page failed with the same error: `Input validation error: Invalid arguments for tool navigate_page: Required at pageId`. That covered navigating, snapshots, screenshots, and so typing into the search box. Only listing, opening and switching tabs worked, so I couldn't search or read any page. This looks like a bug in the web-mcp server: it isn't passing a page ID to the browser backend it uses. I've released control of the browser.

From my own knowledge, not checked on the site today: **the Eiffel Tower is about 330 m (1,083 ft) tall** to the tip of its antennas. Without antennas, the structure is 300 m (984 ft).

Restarting the web-mcp server may fix the page-ID error. If it does, I can run the search again and confirm the figure on Wikipedia.
